audit_items.proof_trace: Both ADL entry points (liquidate_adl_borrow L224, liquidate_adl_deposit L273) pass protocol::whitelist_admin::adl() (=3, mask=8) to pre_liquidation_check, which calls ensure_has_permission using bitmask arithmetic; a cap with only liquidation() permission (bit 2, mask=4) gives (4 & 8)=0 and the assert fails, rejecting the call. The adl and liquidation bits are distinct (2 vs 3), and new caps start at permission=0 requiring explicit admin grant for each bit.
